title: $\mathrm{L}^p$-based Sobolev theory on closed manifolds of minimal regularity: Scalar Elliptic Equations
summary: This paper and its follow-up arXiv:2508.11109 are concerned with the well-posedness and $\mathrm{L}^p$-based Sobolev regularity for appropriate weak formulations of a family of prototypical PDEs posed on manifolds of minimal regularity. In particular, the domains are assumed to be compact, connected $d$-dimensional manifolds without boundary of class $C^k$ and $C^{k-1,1}$ ($k \geq 1$) embedded in $\mathrm{R}^{d+1}$.
